name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response was: "Hello in Spanish is **Hola**. (Pronounced "OH-lah")". I followed the quickstart's Python (OpenAI SDK) path: installed openai, set the base_url to https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1, used the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable, and called client.chat.completions.create().
deviations: The quickstart specifies model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I queried the available models endpoint and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2" (a currently available chat model), after which the call succeeded.
